meta.project: Sistema de Controle de Uniformes Escolares

product_overview: Plataforma web (SPA) para gestão centralizada de recebimento, inventário e transferência de uniformes das unidades escolares da rede municipal, com controle de acesso por perfil (Admin / Escola) e integração com Supabase.
core_goals: Permitir que cada escola registre e acompanhe o recebimento de uniformes de forma simples e auditável.
Dar à Secretaria visibilidade em tempo real do status de recebimento por unidade e gerar relatórios exportáveis.
Gerenciar catálogo de uniformes, estoque e transferências entre unidades com rastreabilidade.
Prover administração segura de usuários e dados via Edge Functions e políticas RLS no banco.
Oferecer experiência responsiva e acessível (PWA, dark mode, persistência de sessão).

features.name: User Login
features.description: Autenticação de usuários via Supabase Auth com e-mail e senha; sessão persistente e redirecionamento para a aplicação principal.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click login button to submit -> Redirect to / -> See user name in header
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill incorrect password -> Click login button to submit -> See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Recebimentos (Receipt Registration)
features.description: Formulário para escolas registrarem recebimento de uniformes por modelo, tamanho e quantidade; listagem e filtros por ano/modelo.
user_flows: Navigate to /recebimentos -> Select uniform model from dropdown -> Enter description -> Select size -> Enter quantity -> Click save button to register receipt -> See new receipt in table -> Filter by year and model -> See filtered results

Navigate to /recebimentos -> Select uniform model from dropdown -> Leave quantity empty -> Click save button to register receipt -> See validation error for quantity -> Fill quantity -> Click save button to register receipt -> See new receipt in table

features.name: Controle de Recebimento (Admin Receipt Control)
features.description: Painel administrativo com resumo de unidades (concluído/pendente), busca e filtros, modal de detalhes por escola e exportação em PDF.
user_flows: Navigate to /controle-recebimento -> See summary cards (total schools, completed, pending, adhesion rate) -> Search schools by name -> Filter by segment -> Filter by status -> Click a school row to see receipt details in a modal -> Click Export report to PDF -> Download PDF
Navigate to /controle-recebimento -> Apply filters that return no results -> See empty state message -> Click Refresh data -> See error notification 'Failed to load data' (API error)

features.name: Transferencias (Transfers Between Schools)
features.description: Registrar e acompanhar transferências de uniformes entre unidades com itens, motivo e histórico.
user_flows: Navigate to /transferencias -> Select origin school -> Select destination school -> Add transfer items (product, quantity, reason) -> Click submit to create transfer -> See transfer listed in transfer history

Navigate to /transferencias -> Select origin school -> Select destination school -> Add transfer items with quantity exceeding available -> Click submit to create transfer -> See error message about insufficient stock

features.name: Gestão de Usuários (User Management)
features.description: CRUD de contas de usuário (Admin / Escola) usando Edge Function segura para criação/edição/exclusão e vinculação a unidade escolar.
user_flows: Navigate to /config-usuarios -> Click create new user -> Fill name, email, password fields -> Select profile type (Admin or Escola) -> If Escola select associated school -> Click save to create user -> See new user in users table
Navigate to /config-usuarios -> Click create new user -> Fill name and email but leave password empty -> Click save to create user -> See validation error for password
Navigate to /config-usuarios -> Click create new user -> Fill required fields -> Click save to create user -> See error notification 'Admin Edge Function not available' (Edge Function not deployed)

features.name: Cadastro de Uniformes (Uniform Catalog)
features.description: CRUD de itens de uniforme com segmentação, tamanhos, preço unitário e cálculo de total; exibição em tabela e edição inline.
user_flows: Navigate to /config-uniformes -> Fill description, segment, gender, size, quantity, unit price fields -> Click save to register uniform -> See uniform in table -> Click edit on a uniform -> Update a field -> Click save -> See updated record in table

Navigate to /config-uniformes -> Fill form with empty description or negative quantity -> Click save to register uniform -> See validation error -> Correct fields -> Click save -> See uniform in table

features.name: Unidade Escolar (School Management)
features.description: Cadastro e edição de unidades escolares com segmentos atendidos, status ativo/inativo e vínculo de e-mail para acesso.
user_flows: Navigate to /config-escola -> Fill school name, email, segments -> Toggle active/inactive status -> Click save to register school -> See new school in list
Navigate to /config-escola -> Click edit on an existing school -> Change email to invalid format -> Click save -> See validation error for email

features.name: Dark Mode Toggle
features.description: Alternar entre temas claro e escuro; preferência persiste em localStorage e aplica-se globalmente.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click dark mode toggle button in the header -> See theme switch to dark -> Reload page -> See theme remains dark

Navigate to / -> Click dark mode toggle button in the header -> See theme switch to dark -> Reload page on a browser with localStorage disabled -> See theme revert to previous -> See toast 'Theme persistence unavailable'

features.name: Sidebar Navigation
features.description: Menu lateral com navegação entre módulos e seção 'Configurações' expansível; comportamento responsivo com fechamento automático em mobile.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click menu item 'Recebimentos' in sidebar -> Active view changes to /recebimentos -> On mobile click Configurações to expand -> Click 'Configurações -> Usuarios' -> Sidebar closes automatically -> See /config-usuarios view
Navigate to / on mobile -> Open sidebar -> Click a menu item -> Sidebar fails to close due to error -> See persistent overlay blocking content -> Click Refresh page -> Sidebar restored

features.name: Backup & Restoration
features.description: Exportar e importar dados do sistema para contingência administrativa; operação restrita a perfis administrativos.
user_flows: Navigate to /config-backup -> Click Export data -> Download backup file -> Click Import data -> Select backup file -> Click Restore -> See success notification and restored records
Navigate to /config-backup -> Click Import data -> Select malformed or incompatible file -> Click Restore -> See error message 'Invalid backup file'

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Painel de estatísticas e indicadores para administradores com cartões métricos e possibilidade de drill-down.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin-dashboard -> See stats cards and charts -> Click a metric card to drill into details -> See detailed report view
Navigate to /admin-dashboard as non-admin -> See access denied message or restricted view -> See prompt to contact administrator

features.name: Lancamentos (Inventory Overview)
features.description: Visão geral do inventário de uniformes por unidade, segmento e tipo; filtros e navegação para detalhes de item.
user_flows: Navigate to /lancamentos -> See inventory overview by unit and segment -> Use filters to select a unit -> See filtered inventory rows -> Click a uniform row to view details
Navigate to /lancamentos -> Attempt to load inventory -> See error notification 'Failed to load inventory' due to API error

known_limitations.issue: Single Page Application with client-side routing via state, no URL-based routing
known_limitations.impact: All views are rendered via activeView state, not URL paths. Navigation is done through the sidebar, not URL changes.

known_limitations.issue: User management depends on Edge Function deployment
known_limitations.impact: Create/update/delete user operations require the admin-users Edge Function to be deployed on Supabase
